decisions.reason: Applying the supplied NCA/NH dates to all date fields does not change any allocated-budget value or budget-source rule.
Date-field consistency does not change the handling or status of the missing NCA and 286R contract IDs.
The date-field decision does not alter the approved non-personnel allocation rule or its permitted budget lines.
Applying NCA/NH dates consistently does not change the separate decision to designate the other document as 286R.
The source directs consistent use of supplied dates but does not replace or revise the independently specified seven weeks served.
The date-field application relies on the NCA/NH context but does not change the established fact that NCA and NH refer to the same school.
This candidate records service weekdays and session time slots for Harborview and MS 284; the NCA/NH date-field decision changes none of those attributes.
Date consistency has no effect on the requirement to sign the subcontractor section.
Applying dates to document fields does not necessarily change the actual-session-count compensation formula or the existing HPI session figures.
